HISTORICAL ONLY: retained for v1.6.0/v1.6.1 source reference.
Since v1.6.2 this directory is not built or used by the app.
Current releases bundle the unmodified upstream Windows executable.

Based on Montaro2017/bili_novel_packer 0.2.49, commit
f7ced725879280b39fe613590f600e86070e520c (MIT, see LICENSE).

Only bin/gui.dart and lib/gui_proxy.dart are additions for this fork.
The original interactive entry point is not used by the desktop application.
Build bin/gui.dart, not bin/main.dart. See the repository README.
